purpose: Determine whether SMP contains enough stable component-resolved colony panels for an independent macroecological test of breeding-space contraction.
forbidden_before_gate_closure: computing N_eff or any concentration metric
selecting species or sites because their abundance or concentration results look favorable
changing panel thresholds after opening count outcomes

candidate_component_priority: persistent child site identifier beneath a master site
hierarchy.whole_colony_total: not a component if it aggregates the candidate components
hierarchy.merged_record: exclude unless a provider-supplied outcome-blind crosswalk reconstructs the same component support

panel_support_gate.eligible_year_definition: all frozen components have one interpretable count in the same biological unit in that year
panel_support_gate.roster_rule: component roster must be frozen from identifiers and support metadata only, before count magnitudes are summarized
panel_support_gate.unit_rule: all retained records within a panel must be harmonizable to one biological count unit without using outcome values
panel_support_gate.identity_rule: split, merge, rename or boundary changes must be absent or resolvable from provider metadata before effect inspection

primary_macro_eligibility.decision: If all three minima are met, SMP is eligible as a macroecological validation dataset. Otherwise do not promote it as the main macro validation source.

secondary_use_if_primary_gate_fails: candidate systems for future targeted data requests
next_step: Request a bulk SMP extract containing persistent identifiers, hierarchy, unit/method metadata, count qualifiers, and split/merge/change history; run the support audit before reading count magnitudes.
